data.gender_notes: Mutazah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'Azah, meaning 'to decide, to determine'. In Islamic contexts, it signifies one who is resolved and steadfast in their faith. The name Mutazah carries the meaning “Determined, Decisive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mutazah usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, decisive and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mutazah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
